# Travels

- [Travels Documentation](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/content.md): Learn, integrate, and operate patch-based undo/redo with Travels 3.
- Getting Started
  - [Installation](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/getting-started/installation/content.md): Install Travels 3 and Mutative 2 in a TypeScript or JavaScript application.
  - [Quick Start](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/getting-started/quick-start/content.md): Create a timeline, record edits, navigate history, and restore a snapshot.
  - [Choosing Travels](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/getting-started/choosing-travels/content.md): Understand when patch-based history is a better fit than snapshots, CRDTs, or a simpler undo stack.
- Core Concepts
  - [How Travels Works](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/concepts/how-it-works/content.md): Follow state, forward patches, inverse patches, positions, and branches through one timeline.
  - [State Requirements](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/concepts/state-requirements/content.md): Use state, patch values, paths, and metadata that remain correct through replay and JSON persistence.
  - [History Lifecycle](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/concepts/history-lifecycle/content.md): Manage retained windows, baselines, reset, rebase, trimming, and branch replacement.
- Guides
  - [History Guides](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/guides/content.md): Practical guidance for updates, navigation, grouping, observers, ownership, and failures.
  - [Updating State](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/guides/updating-state/content.md): Use draft mutations, replacement values, metadata, and synchronous updates correctly.
  - [Navigation and Controls](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/guides/navigation-and-controls/content.md): Move through history and expose the right read-only capabilities to UI components.
  - [Archive Mode](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/guides/archive-mode/content.md): Choose automatic entries or explicitly group pending updates with manual archives.
  - [Transactions](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/guides/transactions/content.md): Group synchronous updates into one atomic history entry and one settled observer event.
  - [Tracking and Replacement](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/guides/tracking-and-replacement/content.md): Apply untracked updates, replace authoritative state, and deliberately reset the history baseline.
  - [Mutable Mode](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/guides/mutable-mode/content.md): Preserve reactive object identity while recording reversible patches.
  - [Controlled Journal](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/guides/controlled-journal/content.md): Connect Travels history to a runtime that already owns state and commits.
  - [Observers and Events](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/guides/observers-and-events/content.md): Subscribe to committed transitions and consume shared read-only event data safely.
  - [Error Handling](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/guides/error-handling/content.md): Handle typed operation errors, persistence failures, warnings, and observer errors without corrupting history.
  - [Advanced Patterns](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/guides/advanced-patterns/content.md): Extend Travels with validation, permissions, metadata, logging, and composable wrappers.
- Integrations
  - [Framework Integrations](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/integrations/content.md): Choose immutable, mutable, official-binding, or externally owned history for your state architecture.
  - [React Integration](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/integrations/react/content.md): Bind a Travels timeline to React with useSyncExternalStore and revision-based invalidation.
  - [Vue Integration](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/integrations/vue/content.md): Use immutable refs or preserve a reactive store reference with mutable mode.
  - [Zustand Integration](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/integrations/zustand/content.md): Use zustand-travel v3 or synchronize a core immutable timeline with a Zustand store.
  - [MobX and Pinia](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/integrations/mobx-pinia/content.md): Preserve observable store identity with mutable timelines and explicit undoable writes.
  - [Forms and External Stores](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/integrations/external-stores/content.md): Keep a form manager or state runtime authoritative while adding reliable undo/redo history.
- Persistence
  - [Persistence](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/persistence/content.md): Serialize, validate, store, restore, and migrate complete Travels timelines.
  - [Storage Adapters](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/persistence/storage-adapters/content.md): Production-oriented persistence adapters for Dexie, idb, localForage, and localspace.
  - [Migration and Recovery](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/persistence/migration-and-recovery/content.md): Migrate older snapshots, select validation depth, and recover intentionally from invalid history.
  - [Security and Integrity](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/persistence/security-and-integrity/content.md): Understand what semantic validation proves and where authentication, revisions, and conflict handling belong.
- Migration
  - [Migration Guide](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/migration/content.md): Upgrade to Travels 3 or migrate from snapshot-based history libraries.
- Reference
  - [Configuration Options](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/reference/options/content.md): Reference for timeline creation, restore, persistence, patches, hooks, and Mutative options.
  - [Instance Methods](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/reference/instance-methods/content.md): A task-oriented index of timeline, journal, navigation, history, and persistence methods.
  - [TypeScript Guide](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/reference/typescript/content.md): Infer timeline types, enforce durable state, and use read-only views and open event types safely.
  - [Compatibility Policy](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/reference/compatibility/content.md): Supported runtimes, browsers, state shapes, official bindings, and versioning.
- Resources
  - [Examples](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/resources/examples/content.md): Runnable and copyable Travels examples for core history, frameworks, persistence, and editing applications.
  - [Troubleshooting](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/resources/troubleshooting/content.md): Diagnose common update, navigation, persistence, mutable-mode, and integration problems.
  - [Testing Strategy](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/resources/testing/content.md): Correctness, property-based, browser, mutation, and hot-path performance testing.
  - [Contributing](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/resources/contributing/content.md): Set up the repository, make focused changes, and validate a contribution.
  - [Security Policy](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/resources/security/content.md): Supported versions and the responsible vulnerability reporting process.
  - [Release Checklist](/travels/llms.mdx/docs/resources/release-checklist/content.md): The project checklist for validating and publishing a Travels release.
